title: Position
description: One player's position+facing at an instant. Mirrors a single entry of the VLR 2D-replay `locs` array: [playerId, x, y, angleDeg]. minimapUnits coordinate frame (see common.schema.json vector2). FUTURE for real data / POPULATED for synthetic.

x.description: X in minimapUnits (replay frame, origin top-left).

facingDeg.description: Facing/view yaw in degrees (0..360), as the replay logs it. Null if unavailable.

alive.description: Whether the player was alive at this snapshot (DERIVED).

worldPos.description: Optional 3D world position in game units, only when a true 3D source exists.
